answer: Recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments and verifiable delay primitives create a robust haven against Sybil resistance by rendering identity cloning computationally infeasible. By utilizing sequential delay functions, agents must generate a plume of commitments, each anchored to a unique canyon of cryptographic hash functions, thereby precluding the possibility of forging a convincing identity spoofing attack, as any attempt to clone an identity would inevitably be detectable through the accumulated delay and verification overhead.
